name: Chevening Scholarship
funding: Tuition fees, monthly living stipend, return airfare, visa and arrival allowances.
deadlineNote: Usually closes in autumn (around October/November).
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least two years of work experience.
description: Chevening is the UK government's global scholarship programme, offering future leaders a fully funded one-year master's degree at a UK university. Applicants choose three eligible courses and are assessed on leadership, networking and career plans.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
funding: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend, accommodation contribution and health insurance.
deadlineNote: Usually mid-January; check your country's partner authority.
eligibility: Students from partner countries nominated or approved by their national authority.
description: Funded by the Hungarian government, Stipendium Hungaricum lets students from partner countries study at Hungarian universities in Bachelor, Master and doctoral programmes. Applications go through the Tempus Public Foundation portal.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
funding: Contribution to tuition, travel, installation and living costs, depending on the programme.
deadlineNote: Set by each programme; most close between October and February.
eligibility: Open to students worldwide who meet each consortium's admission requirements.
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are international programmes delivered by a consortium of universities in several countries. Students study in at least two of them and graduate with a joint or multiple degree. Apply directly to the programme you choose.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
funding: Tuition, living stipend, health insurance and airfare, varying by country.
deadlineNote: Deadlines differ by country; many fall between February and October.
eligibility: Citizens of participating countries; apply through your local Fulbright commission or U.S. embassy.
description: The Fulbright Program is one of the best-known international exchange programmes, funding graduate students, scholars and professionals to study or research in the United States. Each country has its own application process and timeline.

name: DAAD Scholarships for Study in Germany
funding: Monthly stipend, health insurance, travel allowance and, for some programmes, tuition support.
deadlineNote: Varies by programme; many close between August and November.
eligibility: Varies by programme; commonly graduates with strong academic records from eligible countries.
description: DAAD funds international graduates and researchers through dozens of programmes, including Helmut-Schmidt, EPOS and research grants for doctoral candidates. Use the DAAD scholarship database to find the one that fits your country and field.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
organization: Gates Cambridge Trust, University of Cambridge
funding: Full cost of studying at Cambridge, including maintenance allowance, airfare and discretionary funding.
deadlineNote: Typically October to early December depending on citizenship and course.
eligibility: Outstanding applicants from outside the UK applying to a full-time postgraduate course.
description: Gates Cambridge funds exceptional international students to pursue a postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge. Selection weighs academic excellence, leadership potential and commitment to improving the lives of others.

name: Rhodes Scholarship
funding: University and college fees, annual stipend, airfare and visa costs.
deadlineNote: Varies by constituency; most close between July and October.
eligibility: Applicants from eligible constituencies worldwide; requirements vary by country.
description: The Rhodes Scholarship is a prestigious postgraduate award for study at the University of Oxford. It covers many constituencies worldwide, each with its own application route and timeline.

name: Commonwealth Scholarships
funding: Tuition fees, airfare, living allowance and other grants.
deadlineNote: Usually between October and December.
eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, usually nominated by a national body or applying directly.
description: Commonwealth Scholarships support talented students from lower and middle income Commonwealth countries to study in the UK. Several schemes exist for master's and PhD study.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
funding: Tuition fees, living expenses, travel grant and insurance.
deadlineNote: Typically opens in autumn and closes around January.
eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries with work or leadership experience, applying to a Swedish master's programme.
description: The Swedish Institute funds master's studies in Sweden for future global leaders and change-makers from selected countries. Applicants must first apply for admission to an eligible programme.

name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
organization: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
funding: Tuition exemption, monthly allowance and round-trip airfare.
deadlineNote: Embassy track usually runs April to June; university track varies.
eligibility: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan who meet age and academic requirements.
description: MEXT scholarships fund international students at Japanese universities, from undergraduate to doctoral level. Apply through a Japanese embassy or through a participating university.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
funding: Airfare, monthly allowance, tuition, language training and medical insurance.
deadlineNote: Embassy track usually closes in March; university track varies.
eligibility: International students from eligible countries; cannot already hold Korean citizenship.
description: The Korean government's GKS programme invites international students to study at Korean universities, including a year of Korean language training. Applications go through embassies or participating universities.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
funding: Tuition, accommodation, living allowance and medical insurance.
deadlineNote: Varies by track; many close between January and April.
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health meeting academic requirements for the chosen level.
description: The CSC funds international students to study at Chinese universities across many fields. Applicants can apply through the Chinese embassy in their country or through a university's own scholarship channel.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
funding: Full tuition, return air travel, establishment allowance, living expenses and health cover.
deadlineNote: Usually opens in February and closes around April; varies by country.
eligibility: Citizens of eligible Indo-Pacific, African and other partner countries.
description: Australia Awards offer long-term development scholarships for people from partner countries to study in Australia and build skills to contribute to their home country's development.

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
funding: CAD 50,000 per year for up to three years of doctoral study.
deadlineNote: Nominations through the university; internal deadlines typically fall in the autumn.
eligibility: Doctoral students nominated by a Canadian institution; open to Canadian and international students.
description: The Vanier programme attracts and retains world-class doctoral students to Canadian universities. Candidates must be nominated by their institution and show leadership and academic excellence.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
funding: Monthly allowance, international travel, health insurance and cultural activities.
deadlineNote: Usually in early January; applications are submitted by the French institution.
eligibility: International students nominated by a French higher education institution.
description: The Eiffel programme helps French institutions attract top international students at master's and PhD level in selected fields, including engineering, economics, law and political science.

name: Türkiye Bursları Scholarships
organization: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities
funding: Tuition, accommodation, monthly stipend, health insurance, airfare and Turkish language course.
deadlineNote: Applications usually run from January to February.
eligibility: International students under the age limit for their level, with strong grades.
description: Türkiye Bursları is the Turkish government's flagship scholarship for international students at all degree levels, with a language preparation year included.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
funding: Full tuition, stipend, travel and access to leadership programming.
deadlineNote: Usually early October each year.
eligibility: Applicants to any Stanford graduate programme who earned a first degree in the last seven years.
description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars brings graduate students from across Stanford together in a multidisciplinary leadership community, fully funding their studies in any field.

name: Schwarzman Scholars
funding: Tuition, room and board, round-trip travel, health insurance and stipend.
deadlineNote: Typically closes in late September or early October.
eligibility: Students and recent graduates aged 18 to 28 from any country.
description: Schwarzman Scholars is a one-year master's programme in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, designed to develop the next generation of global leaders.

name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
funding: Tuition, accommodation, living stipend, books and mentoring support, depending on the partner.
deadlineNote: Set by each partner university.
eligibility: Academically talented young people from Africa with financial need and leadership potential.
description: The programme supports academically talented young people from Africa and the African diaspora through a network of partner universities in Africa, North America and Europe.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship
funding: Mix of grant (50%) and loan (50%) for postgraduate study.
deadlineNote: Usually March each year.
eligibility: Outstanding students from selected developing countries with no other funding source.
description: The Aga Khan Foundation offers a limited number of scholarships each year for postgraduate study to outstanding students from select developing countries who lack other means of funding.

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships
funding: Living, mobility and family allowances plus research and training costs.
deadlineNote: Annual call, typically closing in September.
eligibility: Experienced researchers with a PhD, with mobility rules for the host country.
description: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships fund researchers of any nationality to work on a project at a host organisation in Europe or beyond, for 12 to 24 months.

name: Rotary Foundation Global Grants
funding: Grants starting at USD 30,000 for graduate study in a Rotary area of focus.
deadlineNote: Rolling; apply via a local Rotary club well in advance.
eligibility: Students with a sponsoring Rotary club or district; study must align with an area of focus.
description: Rotary Global Grants support graduate-level study abroad in areas such as peacebuilding, disease prevention, water and sanitation, and economic development.

name: Gilman Scholarship Program
funding: Awards of up to USD 5,000, with additional funds for critical-need languages.
deadlineNote: Spring and fall cycles; check the official site.
eligibility: U.S. undergraduates receiving a Pell Grant who plan to study or intern abroad.
description: The Gilman Scholarship helps U.S. undergraduates with financial need participate in study abroad and internships, broadening the range of students who go overseas.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
funding: Monthly stipend, tuition exemption, health insurance, housing allowance and airfare.
deadlineNote: Set by each country's nominating authority, usually in autumn.
eligibility: Foreign researchers and artists with a master's degree or PhD from eligible countries.
description: These scholarships promote international exchange and research cooperation between Switzerland and over 180 other countries for doctoral and postdoctoral research.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
funding: Tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years.
deadlineNote: Nominated by school; deadlines typically in November/December.
eligibility: International students in their final year of secondary school, nominated by their school.
description: The Pearson Scholarship recognises international students with exceptional academic achievement, creativity and leadership, covering four years of undergraduate study at the University of Toronto.

name: Holland Scholarship
organization: Dutch Ministry of Education and Dutch universities
funding: One-off payment of EUR 5,000 in the first year of study.
deadlineNote: Set by each university, typically between February and May.
eligibility: Non-EEA students applying to a participating Dutch university.
description: The Holland Scholarship supports international students from outside the European Economic Area who are starting a bachelor's or master's programme at a Dutch university.

name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
funding: Tuition, monthly subsistence, travel, health insurance and a one-time travel allowance.
deadlineNote: Varies by year and host programme; check the programme page.
eligibility: Citizens of World Bank member countries with at least 3 years of development-related work experience.
description: The programme supports mid-career professionals from developing countries in master's study in development-related fields at partner universities worldwide.

name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme
funding: Living costs and tuition waiver for the duration of the master's programme.
deadlineNote: Typically December for the following autumn intake.
eligibility: Outstanding bachelor graduates applying to an ETH master's programme.
description: ESOP supports top students from around the world to complete a master's degree at ETH Zurich, one of the leading science and technology universities.

name: Yenching Academy Scholarship
funding: Tuition, accommodation and stipend for the full programme.
deadlineNote: Usually opens in autumn and closes in December.
eligibility: Applicants from any country with a bachelor's degree and strong academic record.
description: The Yenching Academy offers a two-year master's in China Studies at Peking University, with a fully funded scholarship covering most international students.

name: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
funding: Full tuition and college fees plus a living grant.
deadlineNote: Awarded automatically on admission to Oxford based on the January round.
eligibility: Graduate applicants to Oxford who apply by the early-round deadline.
description: Clarendon Scholarships are among Oxford's largest graduate funding schemes, awarded on academic merit to new applicants with no separate application.

name: OAS Academic Scholarships
funding: Partial funding for tuition and, in some cases, living expenses.
deadlineNote: Varies by partner programme.
eligibility: Citizens of OAS member states applying to partner programmes.
description: The OAS offers academic scholarships for graduate study with partner institutions across the Americas and beyond, aimed at professionals from member states.

name: KAUST Graduate Fellowship
organization: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
funding: Tuition, monthly stipend, housing, health insurance and relocation support.
deadlineNote: Rolling rounds, with the main deadline around January.
eligibility: Admitted MS/PhD applicants with strong STEM backgrounds.
description: All admitted KAUST MS/PhD students receive a full fellowship, including tuition, stipend and housing, to pursue research in science and engineering.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
funding: Monthly stipend, tuition fees, one-time settling-in allowance and airfare.
deadlineNote: Two intakes a year; main deadlines typically in June and December.
eligibility: International students with a strong academic record applying to a PhD in science or engineering.
description: SINGA offers PhD students world-class research training with A*STAR institutes and partner Singapore universities, covering living and tuition costs.
